recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no current FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-17925.
issue_request: FHIR-17925 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FM change request for STU3 Claim terminology binding descriptions: update Claim.use to use current values, adjust Claim.priority case, and ensure Claim.information.reason describes the reason for the code.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17925 was found. The 2018-11-05 Claim batch commit afb5ec66 changed the relevant Claim spreadsheet rows: Use binding text moved away from obsolete complete/proposed/exploratory/other text, ProcessPriority moved away from mixed STAT/normal/Deferred case, and the reason element wording was rewritten while FHIR-19460 renamed Claim.information to Claim.supportingInfo.
additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml carries the updated Claim.use values and binding description, lower-case Claim.priority examples and binding description, and Claim.supportingInfo.reason wording that describes why a reason code is supplied in addition to supporting information content. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Claim source already preserves the applied issue intent and no source correction is needed.
